title: Chapter 92 — Pipeline, Relationship & Money Metrics
intro: Pipeline health, base and referral metrics, the income ledger, and forecasting.

sections.title: Pipeline Health
sections.content:
Your pipeline is every open quote and every active conversation. It is the bridge between today's effort and next month's income.

Track: how many quotes are open? What is their total value? What is the average age? Quotes older than 30 days are going stale — either follow up or move them out. How many new quotes did you create this week? If the answer is zero, your pipeline is shrinking and next month will feel it.

sections.title: Relationship Metrics
sections.content:
Track your delivered base: how many customers have you served in the past 12 months? How many have you contacted in the past 90 days? Your delivered base is your most valuable asset — if you are not touching it regularly, you are letting it decay.

Referral tracking: how many referrals did you receive this month? From whom? This tells you which relationships are producing and which need nurturing.

Repeat customer rate: what percentage of your sales are to returning customers? If it is under 20 percent, your post-sale follow-up needs work. Top performers see 30-40 percent of their revenue from repeat customers.

sections.title: The Income Ledger
sections.content:
Track your monthly income — not just the total, but the components. How much came from floor sales? How much from trade? How much from attach? How much from spiffs?

This breakdown tells you where your money actually comes from. If 80 percent is floor sales and 5 percent is trade, there is a massive growth opportunity sitting in your trade pipeline. If attach is 12 percent of your revenue, presenting warranty and accessories more consistently could add 30-40 percent to your take-home.
